releases.headline: 工作区与停靠、相似音效与主题改进

list_en.「设置 → 外观」可导入主题 JSON，导入后立即应用。: Theme JSON files can be imported from Settings → Appearance and are applied immediately.
list_en.无效的主题文件不会改变当前主题。: An invalid theme file leaves the current theme unchanged.
list_en.日夜主题开启时，手动导入立即生效；到下一时段仍按原计划切换。: With day and night themes on, a manual import takes effect at once; the next period still switches as scheduled.
list_en.欢迎页和加载页默认跟随主题，文字颜色按背景调整。: The welcome and loading pages follow the theme by default, with text colour adjusted to the background.
list_en.日夜主题可分别预览、调整或恢复欢迎页的背景、文字和强调色。: The welcome page background, text and accent colours can be previewed, adjusted or reset separately for the day and night themes.
list_en.导入主题时保留文件里的欢迎页配色，也兼容未包含这些配色的旧主题文件。: Importing a theme keeps the welcome page colours in the file, and older theme files without them still import.
list_en.修复工具窗浮动后浅字贴着浅底看不清的问题。: Fixed light text on a light background in floating tool windows.

list: 「设置 → 外观」可导入主题 JSON，导入后立即应用。
无效的主题文件不会改变当前主题。
日夜主题开启时，手动导入立即生效；到下一时段仍按原计划切换。
欢迎页和加载页默认跟随主题，文字颜色按背景调整。

导入主题时保留文件里的欢迎页配色，也兼容未包含这些配色的旧主题文件。
修复工具窗浮动后浅字贴着浅底看不清的问题。

list_en.文件夹索引缺项或不可读时，文件夹搜索仍能找到已经入库的子目录。: Folder search still finds subfolders already in the library when the folder index is incomplete or unreadable.
list_en.完整扫描或暂停保留后，后台补齐封面时自动刷新一次结果列表和封面墙，保留筛选、滚动: After a full scan, or a paused scan that was kept, the results list and cover wall refresh once when background cover filling finishes, keeping filters, scroll position and multi-selection.
list_en.打开未标记为 v2 格式的旧自适应库时，保留已缓存的缩略波形，只补缺失项。: Opening an older adaptive library not marked as v2 keeps its cached mini waveforms and only fills in the missing ones.

list: 文件夹索引缺项或不可读时，文件夹搜索仍能找到已经入库的子目录。
完整扫描或暂停保留后，后台补齐封面时自动刷新一次结果列表和封面墙，保留筛选、滚动位置和多选。
打开未标记为 v2 格式的旧自适应库时，保留已缓存的缩略波形，只补缺失项。

list_en.批量核对素材和构建相似音效索引可并行分析；没有模型时，声学分析也按设定并发数运行: Batch file checks and similar-sound indexing can analyse in parallel; without a model, acoustic analysis also runs at the set concurrency.
list_en.「设置 → 素材库」可设置相似分析并发数，范围 1–16，默认 4；修改后从下一: Settings → Library sets the similar-sound analysis concurrency from 1 to 16, 4 by default; a change applies from the next analysis run.
list_en.等待首个分析结果超过 100 毫秒时，不再误报任务已取消。: Waiting more than 100 ms for the first analysis result no longer reports the task as cancelled.
list_en.相似音效面板在停靠和浮动时使用同一套留白、分析区与表格布局，保留各主题配色。: The Similar Sounds panel uses the same spacing, analysis area and table layout when docked or floating, keeping each theme’s colours.

list: 批量核对素材和构建相似音效索引可并行分析；没有模型时，声学分析也按设定并发数运行。
「设置 → 素材库」可设置相似分析并发数，范围 1–16，默认 4；修改后从下一轮分析生效。
等待首个分析结果超过 100 毫秒时，不再误报任务已取消。
相似音效面板在停靠和浮动时使用同一套留白、分析区与表格布局，保留各主题配色。

list_en.去掉停靠的波形播放条下方多余的空白。: Removed the extra space under the docked waveform player bar.
list_en.统一筛选器、标签、结果列表、Info 和波形之间的分缝。: Unified the gaps between the filter, tags, results list, Info and waveform.
list_en.鼠标移开后，竖向分隔线的三点手柄仍会显示。: The three-dot handle on vertical dividers stays visible after the pointer moves away.
list_en.分隔条的拖动区域贴合分缝，不再覆盖上层浮窗。: Divider drag areas fit the gaps and no longer cover floating windows above them.
list_en.拼接面板拖到最小可用宽高时停止，不再把控件挤出去。: Joined panels stop at their minimum usable size instead of pushing controls out.
list_en.主窗口变窄时保留拼接的 Info 和筛选器，放不下的内容可在面板内滚动。: When the main window narrows, joined Info and filter panels stay in place, and content that does not fit scrolls within the panel.
list_en.停靠预览按松手后的实际位置和尺寸显示。: The docking preview shows the actual position and size after release.
list_en.插入新停靠面板时，不改变其他已停靠列的宽度。: Inserting a new docked panel leaves the widths of other docked columns unchanged.
list_en.筛选器和传输窗上下拼接时同宽，不留多余空白。: The filter and transport windows share the same width when stacked, without extra space.
list_en.去掉上下拼接时叠在一起的三点，只在实际分隔线上保留手柄。: Removed overlapping three-dot handles in stacked panels; handles remain only on real dividers.
list_en.左右拖动 Info 左边的三点，上下两个窗口会一起变宽或变窄。: Dragging the three dots to the left of Info sideways widens or narrows the two windows above and below together.
list_en.拖动上下两窗之间的横向分隔线，只改变两窗高度。: Dragging the horizontal divider between two stacked windows changes only their heights.
list_en.拖动 Info 右侧的分隔线，只调整 Info 和结果列表的宽度。: Dragging the divider to the right of Info resizes only Info and the results list.
list_en.已有底部横栏时，仍可在横栏内做左右分栏。: A bottom bar can still be split into left and right columns.
list_en.修复已有顶部或底部横栏时，侧栏明明放得下却不能在同一列上下拼接的问题。: Fixed side panels that could not stack in the same column when a top or bottom bar was present, even with enough room.

去掉上下拼接时叠在一起的三点，只在实际分隔线上保留手柄。

list_en.高缩放下，首次建库的三个按钮不再裁切文字。: At high zoom the three buttons in first-time library setup no longer cut off their text.
list_en.首次建库弹窗宽度不足时，按钮按原顺序分行。: When the first-time library setup dialog is too narrow, its buttons wrap in their original order.
list_en.首次建库弹窗和按钮的圆角随界面缩放调整。: Corner radii of the first-time library setup dialog and its buttons follow the interface zoom.
list_en.Windows 覆盖升级后刷新任务栏已固定的默认图标，不替换用户自选图标。: After an in-place upgrade on Windows, pinned taskbar shortcuts using the default icon are refreshed; icons chosen by the user are not replaced.

list: 高缩放下，首次建库的三个按钮不再裁切文字。
首次建库弹窗宽度不足时，按钮按原顺序分行。
首次建库弹窗和按钮的圆角随界面缩放调整。
Windows 覆盖升级后刷新任务栏已固定的默认图标，不替换用户自选图标。

releases.headline: 任务进度看得见，界面缩放与后台执行

list.title: DAW 设置与发送
list.description: 设置中新增 DAW 模块，四款 DAW 同一张卡片；REAPER 可一键安装 Harken 组件并把音效发送到工程。
list.description_en: Settings gain a DAW section with all four DAWs on one card; REAPER can install the Harken components in one click and receive sounds into the project.

list.title: 本机 AI 查找
list.description: 外部 AI 通过本机连接器查找音效、目录和同类替代，只读取已授权的库与路径。
list.description_en: External AI tools can find sounds, folders and similar alternatives through the local connector, reading only authorised libraries and paths.

list.title: 性能监视器
list.description: 原 F10 诊断浮窗改为性能与日志两个页签，可缩放查看帧率、单帧时间和进程占用，并一键导出日志。
list.description_en: The former F10 diagnostics window now has Performance and Log tabs, with zoomable views of frame rate, frame time and process usage, plus one-click log export.

list.title: WavPack 格式
list.description: 支持 WavPack 无损音效的扫描与播放。
list.description_en: Lossless WavPack sounds can be scanned and played.

list.title: 任务进度浮层
list.description: 扫描、相似分析、移除路径、波形与封面重建、导出、Wwise 导入和更新下载的进度统一到主窗口右下角小浮层：最多 3 条，运行中带进度条与百分比，完成后自动收起；失败的会给出原因。原窗口进度可见时不重复显示。
list.description_en: Progress for scans, similarity analysis, path removal, waveform and cover rebuilds, exports, Wwise imports and update downloads is gathered in a small overlay at the bottom right of the main window: up to 3 tasks, running tasks show a bar and percentage, finished ones close on their own, and failures show the reason. Progress already visible in its own window is not repeated.

list.title: 应用内界面缩放
list.description: 设置里可把应用界面缩放到 80%–200%，独立于 Windows 系统缩放，窄屏与高分屏不必再改系统设置。
list.description_en: Settings can scale the interface from 80% to 200%, independent of Windows display scaling, so narrow and high-DPI screens no longer need system changes.

list.title: 拖出音效
list.description: 从结果里拖出音效时主波形缩成跟手小卡，落点轻轻下沉后迅速淡出。
list.description_en: When a sound is dragged out of the results, the main waveform shrinks into a small card that follows the pointer, settles gently at the drop point and fades quickly.

list.title: 顶栏与菜单
list.description: 顶部导航改为紧凑布局，菜单字号跟随系统字体，页面菜单与结果右键菜单外观统一。
list.description_en: The top navigation uses a compact layout, menu text follows the system font size, and page menus match the results context menu.

list.title: 文件夹树与侧栏
list.description: 侧栏按新的规格局重排，刷新、定位和收起都有明确反馈。
list.description_en: The sidebar is rearranged to the new layout, with clear feedback for refresh, locate and collapse.

list.title: 开屏与设置
list.description: 欢迎页与开屏共用同一套机器人头像动效，设置过头像的用户直接看到自己的头像；设置项数值居中，主题色块对齐，AI 语音识别面板的模型区与页签更简洁。
list.description_en: The welcome page and splash screen share the same robot avatar animation, and users with a custom avatar see their own; setting values are centred, theme swatches aligned, and the model area and tabs of the AI speech recognition panel are simpler.

list.title: 后台执行
list.description: 移除路径、扫描与路径查新、单通道导出、Wwise 传输都改到后台执行：主界面不再卡顿，Wwise 传输显示「传输中 N / M」并禁止中途切换工程。
list.description_en: Path removal, scanning and path checks, single-channel export and Wwise transfer now run in the background: the main window no longer stalls, and Wwise transfer shows “Transferring N / M” and blocks switching projects midway.

list.title: 主题保存位置
list.description: 导入的主题改存到用户数据目录，重启与升级后仍然保留；外观页新增主题下载入口。
list.description_en: Imported themes are stored in the user data folder and survive restarts and upgrades; the Appearance page adds a link to download themes.

list.title: 字体与缩放统一
list.description: 顶部菜单与列表字体上限提高到 36 px，界面 DPI 缩放统一处理，缩放后布局与列宽保持。
list.description_en: The top menu and list fonts go up to 36 px, interface DPI scaling is handled in one place, and layout and column widths are kept after scaling.

list.title: 大库首屏
list.description: 封面墙首屏改读文件序物化索引，波形回写移出界面线程，消除百万级音效库进入主界面后的秒级停顿。
list.description_en: The cover wall’s first screen reads a file-ordered materialised index and waveform write-back leaves the UI thread, removing second-long pauses when entering the main window with a library of a million sounds.

list.title: 大目录浏览
list.description: 文件浏览器按输入缓存排序结果，大目录改为分帧建索引，扫描期间不再反复全量排序。
list.description_en: The file browser caches sorted results per input, and large folders are indexed across frames, so scans no longer trigger repeated full sorts.

list.title: 旧库打开
list.description: 旧波形数据迁移按库只执行一次，减少旧库首次打开等待。
list.description_en: Old waveform data is migrated only once per library, shortening the first open of older libraries.

list.title: 播放列表
list.description: 计数与排序改用集合索引，打开与更新流程分段可诊断。
list.description_en: Counting and sorting use set indexes, and opening and updating are split into stages that can be diagnosed.

list.title: 盘符库根
list.description: 以盘符根作为库目录时不再被判成库外，取消扫描保留已汇总的结果。
list.description_en: A drive root used as the library folder is no longer treated as outside the library, and cancelling a scan keeps the results already gathered.

list.title: 面板与对齐
list.description: 修复停靠面板被压扁、结果中栏错位和名称第三行被裁切。
list.description_en: Fixed squashed docked panels, misaligned middle columns in results, and cut-off third lines of names.

list.title: 诊断与切换
list.description: 修复页签切换卡顿与分段计时不准，F10 导出不再丢字段。
list.description_en: Fixed sluggish tab switching and inaccurate stage timing; F10 export no longer drops fields.

list.title: 扫描不再整目录中断
list.description: 单个文件名编码异常（常见于 macOS 残留文件）以前会让整个目录扫描中断，现在只跳过该条并记录具体路径与原因。
list.title_en: Scans no longer stop on a whole folder
list.description_en: A single file name with a bad encoding (common in leftover macOS files) used to stop the scan of the whole folder; now only that file is skipped, with its path and the reason logged.

list.title: 移除路径容错
list.description: 库索引与主表不一致时先重建索引再重试，不再报 database disk image is malformed；同一库里普通 UNC 与 \\?\UNC\ 两种写法能一次清干净。
list.description_en: When the library index and main table disagree, the index is rebuilt and the removal retried, instead of reporting “database disk image is malformed”; plain UNC and \\?\UNC\ forms in the same library are both cleared in one pass.

list.title: 细节修正
list.description: 音量条按整条宽度分配；正式版菜单隐藏开发自测入口；紧凑顶栏恢复搜索提示。
list.description_en: The volume bar uses its full width; release builds hide the developer self-test menu; the compact top bar shows the search hint again.

releases.headline: 同类替代模型就绪，升级确认与分析入口更稳

list.title: 同类替代模型
list.description: 补齐声音模型与推理运行库，修复正式包中同类替代无法分析的问题。
list.description_en: Added the missing sound model and inference runtime, fixing similar-sound analysis in the release package.

list.title: 更新完成确认
list.description: 修复旧版更新器启动新版时诊断输出干扰健康确认的问题。
list.description_en: Fixed diagnostic output from an older updater interfering with the health check when it starts the new version.

list.title: 相似分析入口
list.description: 首次统计时显示等待状态，统计失败可重试，切库期间不会误启动分析。
list.description_en: The first count shows a waiting state, a failed count can be retried, and switching libraries no longer starts analysis by mistake.

releases.headline: 设置更顺手，扫描与更新更稳，相似音效和播放操作更灵活

list.title: 播放效果显隐
list.description: 可在设置中逐项隐藏播放栏的五组内置效果；隐藏时自动旁通，重新显示后恢复原有开关和参数。
list.description_en: Each of the five built-in effect groups on the playback bar can be hidden in Settings; hidden effects are bypassed, and showing them again restores their previous switches and parameters.

list.title: 相关路径显隐
list.description: 筛选器增加相关路径的显示控制，可按需要收起或恢复。
list.description_en: The filter adds a display control for related paths, so they can be collapsed or restored as needed.

list.title: 相似音效查找
list.description: 试听后直接寻找同类型替代音效，候选结果可拖出到其他软件；补充分析只处理未完成文件，取消重扫保留已有结果，批次进度和失败原因更清楚。
list.description_en: After auditioning, look for similar alternative sounds directly and drag candidates into other software; additional analysis only processes unfinished files, cancelling a rescan keeps existing results, and batch progress and failure reasons are clearer.

list.title: 连续扫描收尾
list.description: 修复极速扫描后接着完整扫描时，待处理的波形、封面或元数据任务可能让扫描一直等待的问题。
list.description_en: Fixed pending waveform, cover or metadata tasks that could keep a full scan waiting when it followed a quick scan.

list.title: 刷新与筛选
list.description: 主动刷新后清空全部筛选并恢复完整文件视图；修复锁定结果页刷新后的状态和待加载结果。
list.description_en: A manual refresh clears all filters and restores the full file view; fixed the state and pending results of a locked results page after refresh.

list.title: 更新与安装
list.description: 改善旧安装目录缺少资源时的升级兼容和中断恢复，修正中文安装协议页的字体显示。
list.description_en: Improved upgrade compatibility and recovery from interruptions when an older install folder lacks resources, and fixed the font on the Chinese licence page of the installer.

list.title: 音效库与结果区
list.description: 修复 Pilot 嵌套音效库目录显示；结果面板拖出、排序、关闭和返回主工作区更顺畅，切换音效库时有轻量状态提示。
list.description_en: Fixed how nested Pilot library folders are shown; dragging out, sorting, closing and returning to the main workspace from the results panel are smoother, with a light status hint when switching libraries.

list.title: 设置与外观
list.description: 设置按类别集中查找和修改，新设置默认高性能，保存失败保留原设置；日夜主题可分别编辑五套配色，外观选择即时预览，字体、行高、扩展名和波形显示按所选设置生效。
list.description_en: Settings are grouped by category for finding and changing them, new settings default to high performance, and a failed save keeps the previous settings; day and night themes can each edit five palettes, appearance choices preview instantly, and font, line height, extensions and waveform display follow the chosen settings.

list.title: 扫描信息
list.description: 扫描窗口更简洁，保留真实进度、速度和总用时；失败原因按类型呈现，结果与过程分开查看。
list.description_en: The scan window is simpler while keeping real progress, speed and total time; failure reasons are shown by type, and results are viewed separately from the process.

list.title: 文本与选择器
list.description: 长文件夹名、筛选条件和元数据更易查看与输入，多个侧栏或浮动窗口中的选择器互不干扰。
list.description_en: Long folder names, filter conditions and metadata are easier to read and enter, and pickers in multiple sidebars or floating windows no longer interfere with each other.

list.title: 头像、主题与播放栏
list.description: 头像选择和裁剪更清晰，读取或保存失败时保留原头像；优化海军蓝等主题的文字对比度、EQ 窄窗口布局，并在关于页补充社区入口。
list.description_en: Choosing and cropping an avatar is clearer, and a failed read or save keeps the current avatar; improved text contrast in themes such as Navy, the EQ layout in narrow windows, and added community links to the About page.

releases.headline: 完善日夜主题、独立筛选、扫描与更新体验

list.title: 日夜主题
list.description: 支持按时间切换白天与黑夜主题，两边均可选择全部五个主题并分别编辑；手动选择和定时设置会在重启后保留。
list.description_en: Themes can switch between day and night by time; both sides can use any of the five themes and be edited separately, and manual choices and schedules are kept after a restart.

list.title: 更新过程提示
list.description: 更新执行期间显示官方 Logo、实际步骤与进度；完成后自动关闭，失败时保留原因。
list.description_en: While an update runs, the official logo, the actual steps and progress are shown; the window closes on success and keeps the reason on failure.

list.title: 关于与法律文档
list.description: 关于页补充 Cindy 致谢、仓库和下载地址，并提供随包法律文档。
list.description_en: The About page adds thanks to Cindy, the repository and download addresses, and the legal documents shipped with the app.

list.title: 独立筛选
list.description: 搜索关键词保留文件夹范围；文件夹、封面、标签和元数据等筛选独立叠加，刷新或清除单项时保留其他条件。
list.description_en: Search keywords keep the folder scope; folder, cover, tag and metadata filters stack independently, and refreshing or clearing one keeps the others.

list.title: 扫描收尾与再次扫描
list.description: 修复右键快速扫描不能正常收尾，以及暂停保留后重启再次扫描的问题。
list.description_en: Fixed quick scans from the context menu that did not finish properly, and rescans after restarting from a paused scan that was kept.

list.title: 中文描述与封面
list.description: 修复数据库列表中可识别的旧中文描述乱码，并补齐播放列表封面墙中的真实封面。
list.description_en: Fixed garbled older Chinese descriptions that can be recognised in the database list, and filled in real covers on the playlist cover wall.

list.title: 丢失文件重新关联
list.description: 完善单个与批量重新关联的确认、结果和冲突提示，改善窄窗口下的操作。
list.description_en: Improved confirmation, results and conflict messages for single and batch relinking, and the controls in narrow windows.

list.title: 关闭按钮与控件裁切
list.description: 应用内关闭 X 去掉底框并居中，修复部分普通按钮裁切；Windows 原生标题栏保持原样。
list.description_en: The in-app close X loses its frame and is centred, and some regular buttons are no longer cut off; the native Windows title bar is unchanged.

list.title: 停靠分隔条与封面闪烁
list.description: 修复左右面板互换后分隔条消失，以及部分窗口尺寸下封面墙反复缩放、闪烁的问题。
list.description_en: Fixed dividers disappearing after swapping the left and right panels, and the cover wall repeatedly resizing and flickering at some window sizes.

list.title: 更新说明显示
list.description: 随包提供完整版本说明与贡献者；本机版本没有精确匹配时显示已有最新记录。
list.description_en: Full release notes and contributors ship with the app; when the installed version has no exact match, the latest available notes are shown.

list.title: 首次建库
list.description: 首次使用时合为一个压暗背景的建库窗口，名称、位置和完整路径直接可见。
list.description_en: First use is combined into one library setup window over a dimmed background, with the name, location and full path visible at once.

list.title: 五主题控件
list.description: 统一普通按钮、相似音效按钮与预设下拉的外观，日夜设置按勾选状态显示。
list.description_en: Regular buttons, similar-sound buttons and preset drop-downs look the same, and day and night settings appear according to their checkboxes.

list.title: 大库响应
list.description: 相似音效与后台补全减少同步统计造成的界面停顿。
list.description_en: Similar sounds and background filling cause fewer UI pauses from synchronous counting.

list.title: 诊断日志
list.description: 诊断界面和相关导出保留最近一分钟的日志，满容量时保留新记录。
list.description_en: The diagnostics view and its exports keep the last minute of logs, keeping new entries when full.

list.title: 更新缓存
list.description: 成功升级并确认新版启动后，更新器下载区保留当前版本和上一版本，清理更早的旧缓存。
list.description_en: After a successful upgrade and confirmed launch, the updater download folder keeps the current and previous versions and clears older caches.

list.title: 竖屏与封面浏览
list.description: 扩大 Info 上下停靠的高度调整范围；封面墙支持更小封面和更多列；Info 相似音效入口可隐藏并记住选择。
list.description_en: Info docked above or below has a wider height range; the cover wall supports smaller covers and more columns; the similar-sound entry in Info can be hidden and the choice is remembered.

releases.headline: 优化竖屏停靠、封面墙与相似音效入口

list.title: 竖屏停靠
list.description: Info 在文件列表上方或下方停靠时，可以在更大范围内调整高度，并记住调整后的布局。
list.description_en: When Info is docked above or below the file list, its height can be adjusted over a wider range and the layout is remembered.

list.title: 小封面浏览
list.description: 封面尺寸调到最小时可显示更小封面和更多列，宽面板中不再被自动铺满放大。
list.description_en: At the smallest cover size, smaller covers and more columns are shown, and wide panels no longer stretch them to fill.

list.title: 相似音效入口
list.description: 相似音效图标移到 Info 图标组最左，与其他图标对齐；可在省略号菜单中隐藏或恢复，重启会记住选择。
list.description_en: The similar-sound icon moves to the far left of the Info icon group, aligned with the others; it can be hidden or restored from the ellipsis menu, and the choice is kept after a restart.

list.title: 停靠分隔条
list.description: 修复筛选器与 Info 互换左右位置后，三点拖拽区域消失的问题。
list.description_en: Fixed the three-dot drag area disappearing after the filter and Info swap sides.

list.title: 封面墙闪烁
list.description: 修复部分窗口尺寸下封面墙反复缩放、闪烁的问题。
list.description_en: Fixed the cover wall repeatedly resizing and flickering at some window sizes.

releases.headline: 改善窗口停靠、Info 编辑与五主题显示

list.title: 窗口停靠
list.description: 靠近边缘才显示停靠预览；文件列表上下支持停靠、调整高度和恢复布局，方便竖屏使用。
list.description_en: The docking preview appears only near an edge; the file list supports docking above and below, height adjustment and layout restore, for easier use on portrait screens.

list.title: Info 面板
list.description: 标题栏图标切换详情页，支持选择显示的页面；双击编辑元数据，离开前可保存或放弃，保存失败保留编辑内容。
list.description_en: Title bar icons switch detail pages, and the shown pages can be chosen; double-click to edit metadata, save or discard before leaving, and a failed save keeps the edits.

list.title: 五主题显示
list.description: 统一 Info 与相似音效面板的边框和留白，改善播放栏、EQ 状态和空库文字的可读性。
list.description_en: Info and Similar Sounds panels share the same borders and spacing, and text in the playback bar, EQ status and empty libraries is easier to read.

list.title: 搜索与更新入口
list.description: 点击搜索框即隐藏提示文字，更新历史统一放入更新中心。
list.description_en: Clicking the search box hides the hint text, and update history is gathered in the Update Center.

list.title: 界面操作
list.description: 修复 Info 内容越过右边框、浮窗跨屏后点击失灵、任务栏恢复丢失最大化状态，以及小波形闪烁的问题。
list.description_en: Fixed Info content crossing the right border, floating windows that stopped responding after moving across screens, restore from the taskbar losing the maximised state, and flickering mini waveforms.

list.title: 素材库浏览
list.description: 修复全局封面墙刷新、重复封面及合并封面成员不完整的问题；文件夹快捷入口保留原来的浏览模式。
list.description_en: Fixed global cover wall refresh, duplicate covers and incomplete members of merged covers; folder shortcuts keep the previous browsing mode.

list.title: 扫描诊断与安装
list.description: 记录扫描时数据库打开失败的原因，长中文路径提示保持完整；安装包不再生成多余的 Auro 程序副本。
list.description_en: Scans record why a database failed to open, long Chinese path messages stay complete, and the installer no longer creates an extra copy of the Auro program.

releases.headline: 开源仓库与更新入口迁移

list.title: 开源仓库
list.description: 源码与后续版本迁入 Harken Search 公开仓库，开发改动通过 PR 审查合入。
list.description_en: The source code and future releases move to the public Harken Search repository, with changes merged through PR review.

list.title: 更新下载
list.description: 新版使用新仓库更新入口，旧版继续通过原有入口升级，保留原有安装位置和用户数据。
list.description_en: New versions use the new repository’s update entry, while older versions keep upgrading through the original one, keeping the install location and user data.

releases.headline: 更新应用图标，完善窗口停靠与安装体验

list.title: 透明底应用图标
list.description: Windows 应用、安装器和工具栏统一使用新版透明底 Search 图标。
list.description_en: The Windows app, installer and toolbar now share the new Search icon with a transparent background.

list.title: 频谱分析说明
list.description: 统一高级频谱分析、频谱开关和 FFT 提示的中英日文说明。
list.description_en: Unified the Chinese, English and Japanese text for advanced spectrum analysis, the spectrum switch and FFT hints.

list.title: 窗口停靠
list.description: 完善功能窗口的浮动、吸附和分屏操作，恢复 Info 面板的相关操作。
list.description_en: Refined floating, snapping and split-screen behaviour for tool windows, and restored the related Info panel actions.

list.title: 双语安装向导
list.description: 安装向导和协议按系统显示语言使用中文或英文，并随软件提供完整协议文件。
list.description_en: The installer and licence agreements follow the system display language in Chinese or English, and the full agreement files ship with the app.

list.title: 封面浏览
list.description: 全局封面墙继续读取列表首页以外的封面，保持完整文件库的浏览顺序。
list.description_en: The global cover wall keeps loading covers beyond the first page of the list, preserving the browsing order of the whole library.

list.title: 升级兼容
list.description: 保留旧版自定义快捷键和输出文件名后缀设置，并保持更新包读取与已运行窗口唤醒的兼容性。
list.description_en: Custom shortcuts and output filename suffixes from earlier versions are kept, and reading update packages plus waking a running window stay compatible.

list.title: 扫描错误提示
list.description: 修复显示扫描错误时可能导致程序异常退出的问题。
list.description_en: Fixed a crash that could occur while a scan error was being shown.

releases.headline: 恢复安装版欢迎页并修复自动更新

list.title: 自动更新
list.description: 修复部分 Windows 文件属性导致更新中断、新版启动后清理失败，以及启动失败仍显示更新成功的问题。
list.description_en: Fixed Windows file attributes that interrupted updates, failed cleanup after the new version started, and a failed launch that still reported a successful update.

list.title: 更新后启动
list.description: 移除旧登录页对启动的阻塞，让更新后的程序正常完成启动确认。
list.description_en: Removed the old sign-in page that blocked startup, so an updated app can finish its launch confirmation.

list.title: 安装版启动与旧库
list.description: 恢复安装版欢迎页和网页加载页，修复旧库读取、搜索及多声道发送中的异常。
list.title_en: Installed build startup and older libraries
list.description_en: Restored the welcome and web loading pages for the installed build, and fixed errors when reading older libraries, searching, and sending multichannel audio.

releases.headline: 自动更新闭环终点验证

list.title: 空版本 bump
list.description: 让 v1.0.10 客户端(含 IsSafePlan 修复)完整跑一遍 check + download + restart 闭环。若一切顺利,更新中心将显示可用版本 v1.0.11,点立即更新后自动完成升级。

releases.headline: 修复:客户端 IsSafePlan 硬编码 xindong/aris 前缀,导致新仓库下所有自动下载被拒

list.title: IsSafePlan 与恢复元数据校验不再硬编码 xindong/aris
list.description: src/platform/update_http_transport.cpp:76 (IsSafePlan) 和 src/platform/update_persistence_port.cpp:692 (ObserveResumeMetadata) 都硬编码了 https://github.com/xindong/aris/releases/download/ 前缀。今天早上把发布仓库迁到 zhongziyu-cmd/aris-releases 后,manifest 里的 asset.url 变了,但这两个校验点没跟着改,导致所有下载在 IsSafePlan 阶段就 return InvalidPlan。改成使用 ARIS_UPDATE_GITHUB_RELEASE_DOWNLOAD_PREFIX 宏(与其他 URL 校验点一致),仓库迁移只需改一处 CMake 参数即可全局生效。

releases.headline: 触发 v1.0.8 客户端捕获真实下载错误

list.title: 空版本 bump
list.description: 无功能改动。让装了 v1.0.8(含 HTTP 传输层全分支错误细节)的客户端尝试拉本版本,若下载失败则显示真实的 WinInet/系统错误码,而不是笼统 update protocol failure。

releases.headline: 下载错误覆盖 HTTP 传输层全部失败路径

list.title: InvalidPlan/SinkRejected/Cancelled 也带具体细节
list.description: v1.0.6 只让 sink 内部的失败点带具体 detail;HTTP 传输层本身返回 InvalidPlan/SinkRejected/Cancelled 时,sink.errorDetail() 是空,line 692 fallback 到笼统的 update protocol failure。改成所有 HttpTransportExecutionError 分支都合成具体 detail,并把 WinInet/系统错误码 systemError 也带上,方便定位 timeout/DNS/连接被拒/SSL 等真实 bug。

releases.headline: 更新拉取端到端二次验证

list.title: 空版本 bump
list.description: 用来让装了 v1.0.6(含错误细节 propagate)的客户端尝试拉本版本,若下载再失败,更新中心将显示具体细节而不是笼统的 update protocol failure。无功能改动。

releases.headline: 下载失败给出具体原因

list.title: 下载错误细节 propagate
list.description: 更新中心之前只会显示笼统的 update protocol failure,把真实原因盖住。改造下载 sink,在每个失败点记录具体细节(HTTP 状态与 content-length、chunk offset、staged size、SHA-256 mismatch 等),用户点检查更新看到的将是可追踪的具体原因。

releases.headline: 更新拉取通道端到端验证

list.title: 更新流程闭环测试
list.description: 空版本号 bump,用于端到端验证 v1.0.4 客户端能否正常检测到新版本、下载、验签、Bootstrap 交接、重启并升级到 v1.0.5。无功能改动。

releases.headline: 更新检查允许 GitHub 同源重定向

list.title: 更新检查重定向被误拒
list.description: GitHub 会先把 /releases/latest/download/ 302 到 /releases/download/vX.Y.Z/,再 302 到 CDN。之前客户端只允许 CDN 主机作为重定向目标,导致 v1.0.3 更新检查报 update check redirect is not approved。修复后同一仓库路径前缀的中间跳转也被允许,加密与仓库替换检查保持不变。

releases.headline: Aris 更新中心与热更新闭环

list.title: 更新中心
list.description: 加入可手动检查、下载进度、立即更新、版本日期、贡献者与历史版本滚动加载。

list.title: GitHub 热更新通道
list.description: 正式构建默认从 GitHub Releases 获取签名清单与更新包，内网镜像仅保留为显式 QA 配置。

list.title: 立即更新无响应
list.description: Bootstrap 改为从已验证的 staging 目录启动，完成旧进程等待、文件替换、健康确认与重启交接。

list.title: 更新失败可见
list.description: Bootstrap 交接失败会回到可重试状态并在更新中心显示原因，不再静默无响应。

releases.headline: Aris 自动更新与更新内容视图

list.title: 自动更新基础链路
list.description: 加入签名清单校验、下载恢复、Bootstrap 替换与健康确认基础流程。

list.title: 更新内容视图
list.description: 展示版本、日期、变更数量、贡献者和历史版本，并支持滚动加载。

list.title: 帮助菜单入口
list.description: 在帮助菜单保留更新中心与更新日志入口。

list.title: 发布工作流输入安全
list.description: 发布元数据改由环境变量传递，避免命令行表达式注入。

list.title: 更新检查取消
list.description: WinINet 请求生命周期支持有界超时和取消。

releases.headline: Aris 开源单一版本与 Cuevi foundation

list.title: 统一完整功能版本
list.description: 移除 Basic 与 Ultimate 的功能分流，保留单一完整版本。

list.title: Cuevi 集成基线
list.description: 将反馈与需求流程对齐到 Cuevi foundation 基线。

releases.headline: Aris 首个公开测试版本

list.title: 声音资产浏览
list.description: 提供筛选、波形预览、播放和文件信息工作流。

list.title: DAW 集成
list.description: 提供 Pro Tools 与 Reaper 的基础发送与定位能力。
